0022600184.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-3) are 2-2 at home and 2-1 on the road, have lost their last game, and sit 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, and 9th in the West. The San Antonio Spurs (5-2) are on a five-game winning streak, are 3-2 at home and 2-0 on the road, and sit 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and 6th in the West. The Mavericks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 122-106 in Dallas on October 24, and they lost all four meetings in 2025-26; Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, Kyrie Irving, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea, and Tarik Biberovic, with Max Christie day-to-day with a hip injury, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance and Tobias Harris.
